questions.question: Please check the translation and quotation format for the petition in Book of the Southern Qi, juan 52. In https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/%E5%8D%97%E9%BD%8A%E6%9B%B8/%E5%8D%B752 the phrases about personal measurements and creating a new calendar occur in different parts of the petition; the Russian source joins them with a dash. Should both versions mark the omission and identify the translator? The original Russian wording is retained.
